build_bipartite_soft_matching: build a token merger using bipartite_soft_matching to reduce tokens by cosine similarity with protected class tokens
build_kth_bipartite_soft_matching: build a token merger using kth_bipartite_soft_matching to merge every kth element with the rest
build_random_bipartite_soft_matching: build a token merger using random_bipartite_soft_matching to randomly select and merge r tokens
run_merge_wavg: run merge_wavg to apply a merge function with weighted average based on token size
run_merge_source: run merge_source to track token adjacency between initial tokens and final merged groups
